idea.title: MemoryMesh — Persistent memory layer for local LLM agents

plan.tagline: Persistent memory layer to make local LLM agents remember everything
plan.problem: Local LLM agents forget context between sessions, requiring manual input of prior knowledge each time
plan.solution: Creates a persistent SQLite-based memory layer that stores agent interactions, context, and learned data for instant recall in future sessions
plan.target_market: Indie hackers building agentic tools, developers prototyping LLM workflows, small businesses automating knowledge tasks
plan.demo_script: Run `meshmem --demo` to see a simulated agent remembering user preferences across 3 sessions without retraining
plan.phuket_angle: Thai tourism businesses could use MeshMem to store guest preferences (dietary restrictions, room preferences) across multiple agent interactions without cloud dependency
